sentences.text: Eddie Yongming Wu has served as chief executive of Alibaba Group since September 2023, bringing the perspective of a long-time insider and one of the company's original 19 co-founders.

He joined as Alibaba's first programmer in 1999, went on to hold chief technology officer roles across several of the group's businesses, and later led the Taobao and Tmall platforms, after studying engineering at Zhejiang University of Technology.
